meta.disclaimer: All values here are deterministic model output derived from official NFL.com data. They are NOT market lines, NOT predictions guaranteed to be accurate, and carry no implied probability of profit.

home_field.note: Estimated only on the 129 games played at a club's own stadium; the 7 neutral-site games are excluded and disclosed rather than pooled in. Mean home margin +0.50 pts, 95% CI [-1.80, +2.79]. The conventional ~+2.5 pt prior IS inside that interval, so this season cannot be used to reject it.

strategies.name: Power rating — only clear edges (|line| ≥ 3.0)
strategies.hypothesis: Filtering to decisive rating gaps raises accuracy.

strategies.name: Recency-weighted power (last 4 games ×2)
strategies.hypothesis: Recent form is more informative than season average.

strategies.name: Power rating — pick the favourite
strategies.hypothesis: A blended off/def points rating identifies the stronger side.

strategies.name: Luck fade — bet against over-performing records
strategies.hypothesis: Clubs whose wins outrun their point differential regress.

strategies.name: Anti-favourite — back the weaker side
strategies.hypothesis: Public bias inflates favourites; the dog has value.

strategies.name: Control — always back the home club
strategies.hypothesis: Baseline: any model must beat blind home backing.

gates: Every input traces to an official NFL.com page and passes the deterministic verifier.
≥ 200 graded legs before any performance claim. Below that the result is indistinguishable from noise.
Brier skill score > 0 versus a 50/50 baseline over the graded sample.
Edge survives removal of the luckiest 20% of outcomes, and does not load on pythagorean residual.
Positive edge in at least 3 of the last 4 temporal folds.
For multi-leg bets the dependence between legs is measured and stated, not assumed to be zero.
Strategy can be executed without data that is unavailable; if odds are required, they must be obtainable.

parlay_math.finding: Measured over 136 games: r(home score, away score) = +0.076. That means the two sides of a game are close to independent, so multiplying the leg probabilities is a defensible approximation for THIS season - but the estimate is weak and is not a licence to assume independence in general. The correlation is estimated on a single partial season, so it is reported with its n and treated as provisional rather than as a structural law.
parlay_math.prop_combo_status: UNMEASURABLE from official sources in this environment: per-game, per-player box scores are not available (only season aggregates), so the correlation between a player's yardage and his club's team total cannot be quantified. See Flagged for Review FL-09.

sign_check.comment: The power-rating line predicts the home side correctly far more often than chance, which confirms the sign convention. If this ever drops below 0.50 the sign has been inverted and every line on the site is wrong.
